svg.title: A close-up of the left eye: a safe mask and three mistakes. Good: a wide almond of bare skin around the eye, fine filigree, and the gems far away at the temple. Avoid: paint right up to the lashes with no eye hole. Avoid: gems and glitter on the eyelid near the lashes. Avoid: thick, blobby gold lines and big dots that look clumsy instead of lacy.
